name: q_governance_metrics_v1
description: Queue-stage test for governance metrics (S06). Validates that complexity metrics are computed and governance actions are suggested.

expected_governance.notes: S06: Governance should compute complexity metrics (apparent_complexity, hubness, duplicate_rate) and suggest one of {bundle, prune, branch, continue}.

notes: This test validates S06 governance infrastructure. For the golden flow (minimal data), the governor should typically suggest 'continue' due to small field size.
